summary: Par Pacific Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its wholly owned subsidiary's issuance of $500 million in 7.375% Senior Notes due 2034 in a private placement under Rule 144A/Regulation S. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by the parent and certain subsidiaries that guarantee the ABL credit facility. Interest is payable semi-annually, and the notes mature June 1, 2034. Redemption provisions include make-whole and equity clawback options, and change-of-control put at 101%. The filing discloses a debt financing, not a special-situation event like an acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring. No terms of a deal, merger, or strategic review are present.
